pages.text: A weak acid and its salt hold a pH set by their ratio: $(thing)pH = pKa + log₁₀([A⁻]/[HA])$(). The $(item)Buffer Tank$() mixes them: $(fluid)Phosphate Buffer$() at the pH of blood, 7.4, from bone meal and sulfuric acid; $(fluid)Ammonia Buffer$() at 9. Too far from a ratio of 1 and there is nothing left to buffer with.
